summary: Restored prior exact artifact and canonical evidence. Completed independent verification of fact 4 against both IASA branches and phase conversions. All five changes supported; all eleven non-retain facts and one non-retain link reconciled with corrections or explicit compiled/timing deferrals. Document and proposal agree; no overrides.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical emission code ignores the spawn result and performs zero-counter bookkeeping before incrementing x14 modulo twelve. Both sustained IASA callbacks call this helper.

Verified joint-48 offsets, table selection, spawn arguments, bookkeeping, normalized audio thresholds and kind branches. The independently inspected item spawner can return null; the caller still advances its bookkeeping.

The aerial animation wrapper calls both shared helpers: frame-zero decrement/clamp, canonical Camera_RequestQuake with QuakeKind_Small, and unchecked modulo attribute x20. No local motion-state transition appears.
The grounded animation wrapper calls the same independently inspected helpers. The proposal uses canonical camera naming rather than the rendered substitution.

Both IASA branches require elapsed threshold, released B and zero x10 to enter ending. Resource clamps and counter updates follow the transition call unconditionally. Startup exhaustion, corresponding terrain conversions, grounded ending dispatch and aerial Fall are supported.

contradictions.reason: Accept superseding fact:487d9050-8f94-4e2b-8336-679948864579 and fact:74c3244a-3e71-44c3-b518-7edcbf084e4d: zero-counter work recurs after modulo-twelve wrapping, rather than being first-emission-only. Allocation failure does not gate subsequent caller bookkeeping.
Accept superseding fact:1fba4cb1-a03f-4a9c-8ef5-6046864df095: resource exhaustion is not an ending condition. The explicit input/counter guards select ending; resource depletion only clamps.

Accept superseding fact:e675c733-9be9-4924-8261-cb5d209d7b3e and fact:ecd41966-b095-4051-83d1-3e0ade789139: the current canonical helper calls Camera_RequestQuake(QuakeKind_Small, ...), not the historical camera symbol and numeric-mode wording.
Accept deferral of fact:293717e0-d271-4724-8b4d-935954bbd1b4. The source establishes 96 enum_t entries and indexed regions, but does not establish compiled byte extent or section identity.
